verdict.rationale: Generating shell commands from natural language is a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows WezTerm offering any AI or natural-language command generation. Its Lua event callbacks and CLI pane control are only developer building blocks someone could use to construct such a feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can type natural language and get the right shell command generated in place
